beats.narration_text: Liam, in for Bear — part four. Physics and weight: a trail echo with ghost copies chasing a slide, noise wobble that settles to stillness, elastic physics with a squash burst on impact, and path cascade — all forty-seven paths raining in from above. Weight is the subject.

Your turn. Paste this: drop my logo from above with a low-damping elastic spring, squash it on impact, and let the forty-seven paths arrive in a staggered cascade. Then tell me which of the two reads heavier — elastic or cascade. Heaviness is a design choice.
Musinique logo, in motion. Part four. Liam, in for Bear.
